research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Dyno Therapeutics is engaged in research and development of dependoparvovirus and variant capsid polypeptides, as described in titles such as Capsid polypeptides and methods of use thereof and Capsid variants and methods of using the same. These innovations focus on delivering payloads, including targeted delivery to the eye for treating trabecular meshwork disorders. Additionally, systems and methods for predicting features of biological sequences using statistical and machine learning models are being developed. These areas define Dyno Therapeutics’ R&D focus.

press_references.value: Dyno Therapeutics Launches Two New AAV Capsids and AI Platform for Rare Disease Therapeutic Development at the 2026 American Society of Gene & Cell Therapy (ASGCT) Annual Meeting

product_launches.description: Dyno Therapeutics launched two new AI-designed AAV gene delivery capsids, Dyno-9zh for cross-species CNS delivery and Dyno-n96 for muscular delivery, optimized for efficient transduction, liver detargeting, and compatibility with existing AAV production processes.

press_references.value: Dyno Therapeutics Launches Dyno Psi-Phi, an Agentic AI Suite for Protein Binder Design, at NVIDIA GTC 2026

product_launches.description: Dyno Therapeutics launched Dyno Psi-Phi, an agentic AI suite for protein binder design, including the Psi-1 model, Phi filters, APIs and Claude Code skills, making these tools available to therapeutic developers and researchers.

press_references.value: Dyno Therapeutics Launches Dyno-yp2, a Top-Performing TfR1-Mediated AAV Capsid, to Further Diversify CNS Delivery Portfolio

product_launches.description: Dyno Therapeutics launched Dyno-yp2, a novel TfR1-mediated AAV gene delivery capsid optimized for CNS delivery with high neuronal transduction and strong liver detargeting, expanding its off-the-shelf capsid portfolio.

press_references.value: Dyno Therapeutics Unveils Best-in-Class Dyno-bn8 AAV Vector for Muscle Gene Therapies, Achieving Therapeutic Delivery With Improved Safety Potential

product_launches.description: Dyno Therapeutics launched Dyno-bn8, an AI-designed AAV vector for skeletal and cardiac muscle delivery, showing therapeutic transduction at a 25-fold lower dose versus existing therapies and available for licensing.

press_references.value: Dyno Therapeutics Launches Three Breakthrough Capsid Delivery Vectors for Next-Generation Eye, Muscle and CNS Gene Therapies at the 2025 American Society of Gene & Cell Therapy (ASGCT) Annual Meeting

product_launches.description: Dyno Therapeutics launched three new AAV capsid gene delivery vectors—Dyno-4z2 for eye delivery, Dyno-3hv for neuromuscular delivery, and Dyno-ahq for CNS delivery—at the 2025 ASGCT Annual Meeting, aiming to advance next-generation gene therapies.

overview_description.description: Dyno Therapeutics is pioneering an artificial intelligence (AI) powered approach to gene therapy. Using machine learning and quantitative high-throughput in vivo experimentation, we are inventing new ways to design gene vectors with a focus on cell-targeting capsid proteins from adeno-associated virus (AAV), the most widely-used vector for gene therapies.

product.name: Dyno AAV Capsid Portfolio
product.description: A portfolio of engineered AAV vectors for targeted gene delivery, including CNS, eye, and muscle-focused capsids such as Dyno bCap 1, Dyno eCap 1, Dyno-bn8, and Dyno-yp2.

product.description: An agentic AI suite for designing protein binders and advancing biological sequence design for therapeutic research.
